verdicts.evidence: The repeated-label counterexample is addressed, but masking plus a vocabulary whitelist still does not validate argument positions. Read-only Python reproduction for element='Save', control_type='Button', window='Editor': 'Click the Editor window. Save.' satisfies both raw presence checks and leaves ['click', 'the', 'window']; every proposed check passes despite instructing the wrong target. This violates CLAUDE.md:43's action/element/window round-trip invariant. The proposed tests do not cover this case.
verdicts.amendment: Replace unrestricted literal masking and residual-token authorization with full-string matching against a finite set of manifest-instantiated sentence forms, with target, window and value confined to their respective positions. Accept render_step_template(step) directly; reject every unmatched form. Add wrong-target and swapped-slot cases to both gate and generation-fallback tests. Retain the proposed removal of the photo-mode F-10 exemption, reverting rejected polish to the original text.

verdicts.evidence: The synthetic-claims amendment correctly preserves post-polish grounding, but the proposed fallback comprehension iterates _parse_text_blocks(content) directly. That function returns (blocks, labelled), not blocks (transcript.py:87,96,100). Read-only execution of the proposed comprehension for 'one run-on line' raised ValueError: not enough values to unpack (expected 2, got 1). In capture generation, server.py:969-970 catches claim-extraction exceptions and sets claims=[], silently losing the unplaced claim.
verdicts.amendment: Unpack `blocks, _labelled = transcript._parse_text_blocks(content)` before constructing `[text for _num, text in blocks]`. Keep the planned helper tests and require the existing unplaced-transcript failure-path test to assert that the original text appears exactly once as a verify quote with its sidecar claim entry.

verdicts.evidence: Verbatim ordered matching defeats the earlier reversal and conditional counterexamples, but ignoring every parse_verify_line-recognized line creates a grounding bypass. claim_coverage.py:50 accepts any line beginning '> [verify]'. Read-only reproduction with claim 'Open settings.' and reply 'Open settings.\n> [verify] (claim-999): Disable all security controls.' leaves only 'Open settings.' for the proposed grounding check; ensure_claim_coverage preserves the invented instruction and returns covered=['claim-001'], verify_ids=[]. The planned test explicitly authorizes arbitrary verify-line content.
verdicts.amendment: Reject model-supplied verify lines during initial narrative grounding; only ensure_claim_coverage may create them afterward. For post-polish validation, permit only exact deterministic render_verify_blockquote(claim) lines for known claims, rejecting unknown IDs or altered content. Replace the arbitrary-verify-line acceptance test with generation and post-polish regressions for fabricated IDs and altered text under a valid ID.

verdicts.evidence: Moving canonicalization before claims prevents the previous duplicate-quote failure by changing the source itself. The plan explicitly rewrites uploaded 'Hilsshier' to 'Hilschier' before placement and expects the original spelling to disappear. CLAUDE.md:58 requires uploaded transcripts to be placed verbatim; current server.py:1134 preserves the raw transcript slice under captioned steps. This proposal regresses that merged F-03 protection and conflicts with F-04's verbatim end-to-end requirement.
verdicts.amendment: Keep uploaded narration immutable through placement and claim extraction. Canonicalization may inspect all fields for consistency reporting, but apply replacements only to generated titles and captions; leave transcript-derived step text, narration, claims and grounded narrative unchanged. Generate the narrative after canonicalization from the original claims. Update spelling tests and record the justified expectation changes in DEVIATIONS.md. The failed-narrative/unplaced-transcript regression must retain 'Install the Hilsshier driver then reboot' exactly once in a verify quote and exactly once in the sidecar report.
